subject: Mathematics
schema_note: Keyed by topic_id (matches maths_syllabus.json). Fields: concepts, formulas, methods, traps, hard_archetypes, banned_easy_templates, out_of_scope.

formulas: f(g(x)) domain = {x in Dom(g): g(x) in Dom(f)}
methods: Check well-definedness of a relation before checking equivalence
Verify injectivity via f(a)=f(b) => a=b; surjectivity by solving y=f(x) for x
traps: Confusing 'into' with 'onto'
Ignoring domain restrictions after composing functions
Assuming a relation is transitive without proof
hard_archetypes: Functional equations solved by substitution (e.g. f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y))
Composite function domain/range chains of 3+ functions
Proving a given relation is/isn't an equivalence relation with an abstract set
banned_easy_templates: Direct 'is this relation reflexive/symmetric/transitive' with no compound reasoning
Plug-in-a-number-and-evaluate f(g(x)) single step
out_of_scope: Group theory / abstract algebra structures beyond relations & functions

formulas: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ) = re^{iθ}
z^n = r^n(cos nθ + i sin nθ)
methods: Convert to polar form before powers/roots
Use rotation (multiply by e^{iθ}) for geometric transformations
traps: Sign errors in argument when point is in 2nd/3rd/4th quadrant
Forgetting argument is defined mod 2π; principal value range (-π, π]
hard_archetypes: Locus problems combining |z-a|=k|z-b| type Apollonius circles
nth roots of unity summed against trigonometric identities
Complex number rotation used to prove geometric properties of triangles
banned_easy_templates: Simple 'find modulus and argument of z=a+ib' with no further step

concepts: Location of roots relative to an interval
formulas: For common root: eliminate x between two quadratics using cross-multiplication
methods: Use sign of f(k) and vertex location for 'roots lie between' problems
Express symmetric expressions (a^2+b^2, a^3+b^3) via sum & product
traps: Forgetting leading coefficient sign when reasoning about f(k) sign
Treating repeated root case (D=0) as two distinct conditions
hard_archetypes: Roots-in-interval problems needing 3 simultaneous conditions (D>=0, f(k) sign, vertex position)
Parametrized quadratics where a condition on roots must hold for all/some parameter values
banned_easy_templates: Plain 'solve for x' quadratic with no parameter or root-location reasoning
out_of_scope: Higher degree polynomial root-finding beyond quadratic (covered lightly under Algebra fundamentals only)

formulas: sum k = n(n+1)/2, sum k^2, sum k^3 (NCERT formulas)
methods: Multiply-and-subtract technique for AGP (arithmetico-geometric) sums
Method of differences for series with non-constant pattern
traps: Applying S_inf formula when |r|>=1
Off-by-one errors in index/number of terms
hard_archetypes: Arithmetico-geometric series requiring the shift-and-subtract technique
Series requiring method of differences before summing
Nested sigma sums combining AP/GP with binomial coefficients
banned_easy_templates: Find nth term of a plain AP/GP with no combination
out_of_scope: Harmonic progression beyond basic relation with AP

methods: Use complementary counting for 'at least one' conditions
Case-split by fixed positions/constraints before applying nCr
traps: Double counting when items are identical
Forgetting circular arrangement divides by n not counts n!
hard_archetypes: Distribution of distinct objects into identical groups (Stirling-style counting)
Multi-constraint seating arrangements (some together, some never together)
Log inequality problems needing domain + monotonicity reasoning together
banned_easy_templates: Plain nCr/nPr evaluation with given numbers, no constraint

methods: Use ratio T_{r+1}/T_r to find greatest term
Differentiate/integrate (1+x)^n to derive coefficient-sum identities
traps: Off-by-one in identifying which term is 'the rth term' vs T_r vs T_{r+1}
Sign errors when b is negative in (a+b)^n expansion
hard_archetypes: Proving binomial coefficient identities via calculus (differentiation/integration trick)
Multinomial-flavoured coefficient extraction problems
Sum of series expressed as coefficients from a cleverly chosen expansion
banned_easy_templates: Expand (a+b)^n fully with small n, no coefficient reasoning
out_of_scope: Binomial theorem for rational/negative index (not in JEE Advanced syllabus)

formulas: Any square matrix = symmetric + skew-symmetric part
methods: Row-reduce augmented matrix to test consistency of a linear system
Use Cramer's rule only for unique-solution 3-variable systems
traps: Applying inverse formula when det(A)=0
Sign errors in cofactor expansion
hard_archetypes: System of equations with a parameter, discuss unique/infinite/no solution cases
Matrix equation problems requiring properties (A^2=A, orthogonal, idempotent) rather than direct computation
Proving determinant identities using row/column operations
banned_easy_templates: Compute determinant of a fixed 2x2/3x3 numeric matrix with no further reasoning
out_of_scope: Eigenvalues/eigenvectors, matrix diagonalization (not in JEE Advanced syllabus)

methods: Draw a tree diagram for multi-stage experiments before writing probabilities
Distinguish 'with replacement' vs 'without replacement' explicitly
traps: Treating independent events as mutually exclusive (or vice versa)
Forgetting to condition correctly in sequential/dependent trials
hard_archetypes: Bayes' theorem with 3+ prior hypotheses and multi-step evidence
Probability of a random variable defined via a game/urn model requiring recursion
Combining P&C counting with conditional probability in one problem
banned_easy_templates: Single coin/die toss probability with no conditioning

concepts: Effect of linear transformation on mean/variance
methods: Use step-deviation/assumed-mean method for large grouped datasets
Apply shortcut variance formula: Var = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2
traps: Using population vs sample variance formula inconsistently
Forgetting variance scales by a^2, not a, under linear transform
hard_archetypes: Given same mean but different variance across two frequency distributions — compare/derive missing frequencies
Reconstruct a dataset given mean & variance constraints (reverse problem)
banned_easy_templates: Compute mean of a small ungrouped list directly
out_of_scope: Correlation and regression (not in JEE Advanced syllabus)

concepts: General solution vs principal solution of trig equations
Conditional trig identities in a triangle
formulas: sin θ = sin α => θ = nπ + (-1)^n α
cos θ = cos α => θ = 2nπ ± α
tan^-1 x + tan^-1 y = tan^-1[(x+y)/(1-xy)] (with domain caveat)
methods: Reduce multi-angle equations to a single trig function before solving
Check inverse-trig identity domain restrictions before combining terms
traps: Applying tan^-1 addition formula outside its valid domain (sign of 1-xy)
Losing solutions by dividing both sides by a trig expression that can be zero
hard_archetypes: General solution problems requiring domain restriction + verification of extraneous roots
Inverse trig equations needing substitution (x=sinθ / x=tanθ) plus range analysis
Triangle identity proofs combining multiple trig formulae
banned_easy_templates: Evaluate a single standard trig value (sin30, cos60) with no equation to solve

concepts: Locus of a variable point under linear constraints
methods: Use family-of-lines to avoid solving for exact intersection point
Determine correct bisector sign by testing a known interior point (e.g. centroid)
traps: Picking the wrong bisector sign (internal vs external) without testing a point
Sign errors in distance formula when line is not in normalized form
hard_archetypes: Locus of orthocentre/circumcentre as a vertex moves under a constraint
Problems combining family of lines with a tangency or distance condition
Reflection of a line/point in another line as an intermediate step
banned_easy_templates: Find distance between two given fixed points/lines with no locus or family reasoning

concepts: Pole-polar relationship (implicit via tangent/chord of contact)
formulas: Family: S1 + λS2 = 0 (circles) or S + λL = 0 (circle+line)
Chord of contact from external point: T = 0
methods: Use radical axis to find common chord without solving simultaneously
Use director circle / chord of contact formulas rather than re-deriving tangents
traps: Forgetting condition for two circles to actually intersect before using common chord
Mixing up chord of contact (T=0) with the tangent equation at a point on the circle
hard_archetypes: Family of circles through intersection of a circle and line, subject to an extra tangency condition
Orthogonal circle construction problems
Locus of midpoint of chords subtending a fixed angle at centre
banned_easy_templates: Find centre and radius of a circle given directly in standard form

concepts: Chord in terms of parameters t1, t2
formulas: Tangent to parabola at t: ty = x + at^2
methods: Use parametric point (at^2, 2at) etc. instead of Cartesian for tangent/normal problems
Apply the reflection/optical property to shortcut ray-path problems
traps: Confusing eccentricity formula direction for ellipse vs hyperbola
Sign errors in directrix location relative to centre for hyperbola
hard_archetypes: Chord joining two parametric points with a locus-of-midpoint requirement
Common tangent to two conics (parabola-ellipse, ellipse-hyperbola)
Problems combining focal chord property with a triangle/area condition
banned_easy_templates: Identify a,b,e from a conic equation given directly in standard form with no further step
out_of_scope: Polar equations of conics, general second-degree conic classification beyond standard forms

concepts: Foot of perpendicular from point to plane/line
Angle and distance formulas in vector/Cartesian form
methods: Convert Cartesian line/plane to vector form before cross/triple products
Use image (reflection) of a point in a plane via foot-of-perpendicular method
traps: Sign/direction errors in normal vector when plane equation isn't normalized
Confusing direction ratios with direction cosines (normalization step skipped)
hard_archetypes: Reflection of a line in a plane
Family of planes through intersection line of two planes with extra constraint
Shortest distance + foot of perpendicular combined multi-part problem
banned_easy_templates: Find direction ratios of a line given two points, no further construction

formulas: L'Hospital: lim f/g = lim f'/g' when 0/0 or inf/inf
methods: Check indeterminate form before applying L'Hospital; reduce algebraically first if possible
Use standard limits + series expansion (e^x, sin x, ln(1+x)) for tricky limits
traps: Applying L'Hospital to a non-indeterminate form
Assuming continuity implies differentiability
hard_archetypes: Piecewise function continuity/differentiability at a junction point requiring parameter solving
Limits requiring series expansion rather than direct substitution or L'Hospital
IVT-based existence proofs for roots of a constructed function
banned_easy_templates: Direct substitution limit with no indeterminate form

formulas: Rolle's: f(a)=f(b) => exists c in (a,b), f'(c)=0
methods: Use first-derivative sign chart for monotonicity/extrema classification
Reduce optimization word problems to single-variable function before differentiating
traps: Forgetting to check endpoints for global extrema on a closed interval
Misapplying Rolle's theorem when f is not differentiable on the open interval
hard_archetypes: Proving an inequality using MVT/Rolle's theorem
Optimization problems with a geometric constraint (min distance, max area) needing implicit differentiation
Existence-of-root proofs combining IVT and Rolle's
banned_easy_templates: Find tangent line at a given point on a simple explicit curve, no further reasoning

concepts: Definite integral via property P1-P6 (King's rule etc.)
Integration of rational functions via partial fractions
Leibniz rule for differentiation under integral sign
formulas: Integral a to b f(x)dx = Integral a to b f(a+b-x)dx
methods: Exploit symmetry (even/odd, periodicity) before brute-force integrating
Choose substitution to convert to a standard/reduction-formula form
traps: Sign errors in partial fraction decomposition for repeated/irreducible factors
Forgetting +C for indefinite integrals in a multi-part derivation
hard_archetypes: Definite integrals solved via King's property / symmetry tricks rather than direct antiderivative
Integrals requiring a clever substitution not visible from the surface form
Leibniz-rule problems involving a function defined by an integral
banned_easy_templates: Standard antiderivative lookup with no manipulation (e.g. integral of x^n)
out_of_scope: Improper integrals with divergence analysis, multiple integrals

concepts: Order and degree of a DE
Area between curves via definite integration
formulas: Linear DE: dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x); IF = e^{Integral P dx}
Solution: y.IF = Integral Q.IF dx + C
methods: Identify DE type (variable separable / homogeneous / linear) before choosing a method
Sketch region roughly before setting up the area integral (avoid sign errors)
traps: Missing the constant of integration when forming the general solution
Wrong integrating factor sign or forgetting exponent simplification
hard_archetypes: DE formation from a geometric property (tangent/normal condition) then solved
Area problems requiring intersection-point computation plus multiple sub-regions
DE problems requiring a non-obvious substitution to reduce to a standard type
banned_easy_templates: Direct variable-separable DE with no formation step or geometric context

concepts: Scalar/vector triple product geometric meaning (volume, coplanarity)
Projection of one vector on another
methods: Convert geometry word problems (area, volume) into vector operations directly
Use component form only after setting up the vector relationship symbolically
traps: Cross product order matters (a×b = -b×a) — sign errors are common
Confusing scalar triple product (number) with vector triple product (vector)
hard_archetypes: Volume/coplanarity problems combined with unknown parameter to solve for
Vector proofs of geometric theorems (e.g. diagonals of a parallelogram)
Combined vector + 3D geometry problems (shared with M14)
banned_easy_templates: Compute dot product of two given numeric vectors with no further step
